gems.name: Ruby
gems.description: A deep red stone of fire. Engrave it to make an item burn with the Fire element.

gems.name: Garnet
gems.description: A common red stone — a lesser ember of the Fire element.

gems.name: Emerald
gems.description: A vivid green stone of living growth, imparting the Wood element.

gems.name: Jade
gems.description: A soft green stone — a humble bearer of the Wood element.

gems.name: Sapphire
gems.description: A cold blue stone of deep water, imparting the Water element.

gems.name: Aquamarine
gems.description: A pale blue stone — a lesser well of the Water element.

gems.name: Topaz
gems.description: A golden-yellow stone of stone and soil, imparting the Earth element.

gems.name: Citrine
gems.description: A pale yellow stone — a humble bearer of the Earth element.

gems.name: Diamond
gems.description: A flawless white stone of hardened edge, imparting the Metal element. The finest conductor of engraving.

gems.name: Moonstone
gems.description: A pale, milky stone — a humble bearer of the Metal element.
